jurisdiction.name: Burundi
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: No official Burundian AI governance document has yet been published in full on the government websites that were checked. The Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy leads digital policy and reports holding a workshop in November 2025 to assess the national AI landscape. A national AI strategy for 2025-2030 is listed as validated in April 2026 (not yet verified from the official text), a personal data protection law was adopted by parliament in 2026 and a national data governance strategy was validated in 2025, but no official text of any of them was found; all three are listed as leads.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy
narrative.review_notes: On 18 October 2026 the websites of the Presidency, the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy, the Senate and the telecom regulator were searched again and none of them yet publishes the AI strategy, the data governance strategy or the data protection law. The National Assembly website and the legislation portal could still not be accessed, so the three documents remain listed as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National-level official sources were searched in French, English and Kirundi, including legislation channels, the Senate, ministries and the central bank. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. Several official sites, including the legislation portal, the National Assembly, the digital economy ministry and the telecom regulator, were unavailable, so the personal data protection law and the national AI and data governance strategies are listed as leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. finances.gov.bi reset/502/DNS; presidence.gov.bi 508/timeout; assemblee.bi reset; amategeko.gov.bi 503 (maintenance); arct.gov.bi 502. brb.bi and senat.bi reachable (nothing on AI). Searches in French, English and Kirundi. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for AI laws, AI provisions and the 2026 personal data protection law; official gazette/legislation channels (presidence.gov.bi, assemblee.bi, amategeko.gov.bi) unreachable; Senate site search: nothing found. Data protection law held as lead (no official text). No AI-specific law or bill found.; Government: National AI Strategy 2025-2030 (validated April 2026) and National Data Governance Strategy (Nov 2025) known only from press/UN reporting; Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy site unreachable; held as leads. Searched, no official document found.; Ministries: Searched in French, English and Kirundi for ministry-level AI documents (education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour, interior): searched, nothing found. Senate 2024 IPU speech on AI is a speech, not an instrument (excluded).; Regulators: Central bank (brb.bi site search): searched, nothing found. ARCT telecom regulator unreachable; no AI documents found via search. No data protection authority yet operating; no cyber agency AI guidance found.. Not reached: finances.gov.bi (Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy) - connection failed (curl and WebFetch); presidence.gov.bi (Presidency / official gazette channel) - HTTP 508 / timeout; assemblee.bi (National Assembly) - connection reset; amategeko.gov.bi (legislation portal) - maintenance 503; arct.gov.bi (telecom regulator) - connection failed. Could not verify: Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026 on personal data protection (number/date from secondary sources only); National AI Strategy 2025-2030 validation and contents; National Data Governance Strategy (Nov 2025). binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection, ~25 min): REACHED via curl HTTP 200: finances.gov.bi (WordPress search: only news items - 25 Nov 2025 opening of a workshop on assessing the AI landscape in Burundi, Feb 2026 Central Africa IGF; no strategy text, no data governance strategy text in Publications/search), presidence.gov.bi (searches for 'données à caractère personnel', 'protection des données', 'intelligence artificielle', 'numérique' found no law or decree on data protection or AI; 'Lois Promulguées' menu lists years only up to 2023; guessed URL /decrets-2026/ 404), arct.gov.bi (searches 'intelligence artificielle', 'données personnelles': no results), senat.bi (search 'données': old reports only, nothing on the 2026 data law surfaced on first page). STILL FAILED: assemblee.bi (curl timeout after ~730 s, headless browser ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED); amategeko.gov.bi (HTTP 503 maintenance page via curl and browser). Not reached in time box: brb.bi re-check, procurement authority, standards body, cyber authority (none known to publish AI material). No instruments added.

leads.title: Stratégie nationale sur l'intelligence artificielle 2025-2030
leads.issuing_authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l'Économie numérique
leads.note: Validated at a workshop in Bujumbura on 21-22 April 2026 with UNDP support (reported by press and UNDP). No official full text found online; ministry website (finances.gov.bi) unreachable by curl and WebFetch on 2026-10-12. Promote once the ministry or presidency publishes the text and adoption is confirmed. 2026-10-18: finances.gov.bi now reachable; site search for 'intelligence artificielle' and 'stratégie nationale' returned only a 25 November 2025 news item on an AI landscape assessment workshop; strategy text not published there; presidency site search also found nothing.

leads.title: Loi n°1/03 du 10 mars 2026 portant protection des données à caractère personnel
leads.english_title: Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026 on the protection of personal data
leads.issuing_authority: Assemblée nationale / Présidence de la République du Burundi
leads.note: Bill (sponsored by the Ministry of Interior) adopted by the National Assembly on 15 January 2026; number and promulgation date 10 March 2026 come only from secondary trackers. Official gazette/presidency (presidence.gov.bi returned HTTP 508), assemblee.bi and amategeko.gov.bi (maintenance) were unreachable; no official text located. Data-privacy instrument; reportedly creates an independent data protection authority. 2026-10-18: presidence.gov.bi now reachable but its site search finds no data protection law and its 'Lois promulguées' list stops at 2023; assemblee.bi still unreachable and amategeko.gov.bi still in maintenance; ARCT site search found nothing. Still no official text.

leads.title: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données (SNGD)
leads.issuing_authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l'Économie numérique
leads.note: Validated 7 November 2025 with UNECA support; seven pillars incl. legal framework and personal data protection; National Action Plan 2026-2028 planned. Only UNECA-hosted speeches found, no official government text. Check whether it has an AI component before promoting. 2026-10-18: finances.gov.bi now reachable; site search for 'gouvernance des données' returned no strategy document.
